messages:
tessa: starting a tiny PR to add 'scale guardrails' examples + SDK snippets for Dedicated capacity onboarding. could use a quick sanity-check on SLA wording and isolation label examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456
mike: vote for both YAML + Python examples. docs users like a copy-paste YAML and a 2-3 line SDK snippet. also: flag any use of 'preemption' w/out explanation.
docs-bot: New PR created by tessa: docs/pull/456 — reviewers requested: @mike @olivia
olivia: small suggestion: add a one-line definition of "isolation labels" at the top of the section so readers understand scope.
tessa: good call. i'll add a short callout and a crosslink to the tenant-labeling guide. also going to document fallback ordering for constrained capacity.
sre-ryan: ops note: include wording about graceful SLO degradation and notifications: "under sustained capacity pressure, latency SLOs may degrade; fallback policies will be applied and customers are notified via console and webhook". mention auto-rollback for canary misconfigs.
tessa: adding that. including an ops snippet for healthchecks + hysteresis (cooldown + min_replicas) to avoid thrash.
olivia: tiny YAML sample (very copyable):
```
# dedicated/provisioning/sample-capacity.yaml
capacity:
  name: my-tenant-pool
  reserved_gpus: 8
  isolation_labels: ["prod", "nl-1"]
  scale_policy:
    target_utilization: 0.65
    cooldown_seconds: 300
    min_replicas: 2
    burst_enabled: true
```
mike: SDK snippet (match SDK v0.8 param names):
```
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
resp = c.create_capacity(name="my-tenant-pool", gpus=8, isolation_labels=["prod","nl-1"])
```
olivia: i'll add a 2-row text table distinguishing "best-effort eviction" vs "hard eviction" for reserved pools. legal asked to avoid absolutes — prefer "aims to" / "targets" over "will".
nora: i can follow up with a migration checklist (shared -> dedicated). where should it live? provisioning/handbook or migration-guides?
tessa: put the checklist under provisioning/handbook and link to migration-guides/migrate-to-dedicated.md
nora: great. i'll PR the checklist after this lands and reference the guardrails.
sre-ryan: also include a short example of fallback policy ordering: same-region reserved -> cross-region reserved -> cheaper hosted variant. keep it prescriptive but not absolute.
mike: small nit: mark the SDK snippet as "example; check SDK for exact signature" if we can't guarantee parity.
tessa: aligning snippet to SDK v0.8 and adding that note. plan: push updates in ~90 minutes, ping reviewers, add changelog entry, merge after approvals. thanks all :thumbsup:
